name: The Defenders
description: The Defenders is a drama about two colorful Las Vegas defense attorneys who go all-in when it comes to representing their clients. Nick and Pete are the local go-to guys with an eclectic client list who are still looking to hit their own jackpot.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Nick and Pete use whatever tactics necessary in order to defend a young man facing murder charges in a case unique to Vegas.

videos.title: Las Vegas v. Reid
videos.overview: Nick Morelli works the system to free a single mother accused of running down a jogger while chit chatting on her cell phone, meanwhile, Pete Kaczmarek does his best to help a man down on his luck.

videos.title: Nevada v. Carter
videos.overview: Nick defends a stripper accused of solicitation; Pete must take on an unwanted case after losing a hand of poker.

videos.title: Nevada v. Cerrato
videos.overview: Nick is ready to accept a simple arson case until he realizes that his client could be convicted of first-degree murder. Meanwhile, Pete helps a lottery winner take on a casino when he loses his fortune after a night of high rolling.

videos.title: Nevada v. Senator Harper
videos.overview: In the middle of a divorce case, a client is charged with the kidnapping and burglary; Pete defends a cabana girl accused of assault and battery.

videos.title: Nevada v. Rodgers
videos.overview: Nick defends a man charged with attempted murder; a man is caught with stolen Elvis memorabilia.

videos.title: Las Vegas v. Black Betty
videos.overview: Nick reluctantly defends an entertainer's girlfriend when she is charged with murder; Lisa's newest client reveals potentially dangerous information.

videos.title: Nevada v. Killa Diz
videos.overview: Nick comes to the defense of a young rapper wanted on two counts of first-degree murder. Meanwhile, Pete takes the case of an Internet hacker facing RICO charges.

videos.title: Whitten v. Fenlee
videos.overview: When a woman's husband dies from a fall on a construction site, Nick and Pete look to prove wrongful death against the company. Meanwhile, Pete tries to help an online blogger avoid jail after exposing an illusionist's magic trick.

videos.title: Nevada v. Dennis
videos.overview: When a young man is pulled over carrying guns with filed-off serial numbers, Nick and Pete try to get the charges thrown out. Meanwhile, Nick agrees to help the ADA's sister save a bear from being euthanized.

videos.title: Nevada v. Riley
videos.overview: Nick and Pete come to the aid of a troubled ex-football player charged with battery. Meanwhile, Pete becomes exasperated when his father shows up in town.

videos.title: Nevada v. Wayne
videos.overview: Nick's personal ties to a young man charged with sexual assault prompt him to defend the accusations. Meanwhile, Pete is stunned when he has jury duty.

videos.title: Nevada v. Donnie the Numbers Guy
videos.overview: Seventeen years after disappearing on the eve of his wife's murder trial, a man from Nick's past returns to Vegas looking to prove his innocence by relying on new technological tools.

videos.title: Nevada v. Doug the Mule
videos.overview: When a young man is pulled over carrying 30 bricks of cocaine, Nick and Pete look to prove their client was duped by a girl he met on spring break.

videos.title: Nevada v. Hunter
videos.overview: Facing thirty counts of possession of a controlled substance, an overconfident judge turns to Nick, who has no choice but to help acquit him of the charges.

videos.title: Noland v. Galloway Pharmaceuticals
videos.overview: Nick and Pete go after a pharmaceutical company for faulty packaging when two victims overdose on the same drug. Lisa is secretly seeing ADA Ward all the while considering a fascinating new job offer.

videos.title: Nevada v. Greene
videos.overview: Unable to recall any events from the previous night, the son of a hotel owner turns to Nick and Pete for help after he awakes to find a casino host strangled to death in a hot tub.

videos.title: Morelli v. Kaczmarek
videos.overview: The firm temporarily dissolves its partnership when they have to defend a husband and wife accused of murder.
